program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights in Osaka with a walking tour, Universal Studios Japan and two free days for Kyoto, Kobe or the food streets.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a guided day through the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Early breakfast, then across to Tokyo Disneyland
Admission tickets included for the full day
4: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone viewpoints
A shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets
5: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Rest of the day free in the city
6: Breakfast, then a half day walking tour of Osaka
Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
The lanes around Shinsekai with your guide
7: Early breakfast, then across to Universal Studios Japan
Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
8: Breakfast and a free day in Osaka
Optional: a day in Kyoto, fifteen minutes by bullet train
Optional: Osaka castle and its park
Optional: Kobe for beef and the harbour
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Two hotels, nine days and two free days. Couples who want Japan without a packing schedule book this one.
expert.tip: Kyoto is fifteen minutes from Shin-Osaka by bullet train, so use a free day for it and go early before the coaches arrive.

summary: Nine days for two between Tokyo and Osaka: four nights in Shinjuku with a city day, Tokyo Disneyland and the Mount Fuji fifth station with the Gotemba outlets, then four nights in Osaka with a walking tour, Universal Studios and free days for Kyoto or Kobe.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; Osaka walking tour; Universal Studios Japan tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
